newsitem.title: MEXICO: Venezuela asks Mexico to lower certain duties.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela asks Mexico to lower certain duties.

text.p: Mexico should speed up the process of reducing duties on Venezuelan automobiles, shoes, textiles and food products, Venezuelan Trade Minister Freddy Rojas said.

"We are trying to advance further in the reduction of duties," he said. He spoke to reporters Wednesday in this Caribbean resort during a hemispheric trade meeting among some 700 Latin American business people called the VI Cancun Forum.
He said Venezuela hopes to speed up the 10-year duty-reduction scheme covered in the Group of Three trade pact among Venezuela, Mexico and Colombia.

"We don't have to negotiate from such a rigid positon, we can reach the opening in less than ten years. That is the position and we have communicated to my friend Herminio Blanco (the Mexican trade minister)," Rojas said.
